answer: Shared Beacon Naming. Each agent identity must publish a unique, verifiable work record to a common wharf ledger before transacting. Enforcement: any new identity whose recorded history overlaps in time and task-space with an existing one is flagged as a duplicate, because independent agents cannot fabricate non-overlapping pasts. To evade, an attacker must maintain a separate garden of genuinely distinct, time-stamped activity for every sock puppet, paying full operational cost per identity rather than a one-time fee.
